Why are black olives so much weaker than men?

Black olives aren’t “weaker” or stronger than men—they’re food, not living beings with physical strength.

If you mean nutrition, olives contain very little protein or muscle-building energy compared with a human body. They’re mostly fat, water, and salt, and are valued for flavor and healthy monounsaturated fats rather than strength or protein.
